svg.aria-label: Homelab on one Raspberry Pi 5 — network and privacy: Pi-hole, Unbound, Tailscale, CrowdSec, Fail2ban, Vaultwarden; home automation: ioBroker (Tuya, Zigbee, Shelly), Telegram alerting; observability: Grafana, Prometheus, Uptime Kuma, Portainer, OLED display; media and knowledge: Immich, Calibre-Web, Kiwix; local ai: Ollama, Open WebUI, LiteLLM; backup: restic to off-site, nightly
